responsibility: Declares a very small SSA-discovery pass for the gm2 quadruple world. It exports a compile-time enable flag and a single routine that scans a scope to identify trivial temporaries that are written once and can therefore be marked as single-assignment for later optimization or code-generation decisions.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file exposes only the tiny SSA-discovery interface—a compile-time enable constant and `DiscoverSSA` entry point—whereas the same-name `.mod` file performs the scope walk and write/read-based temporary analysis.
